```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(highcharter)
hc_set_theme("hcrt", tooltip = list(valueDecimals = 2))
```

## Four panels with their own axes

Plot vehicle weight against fuel economy in `mtcars`. Each column is a
transmission (`am`), each row an engine shape (`vs`). Give the matching X and
Y axes the same panel bounds and bind each series to the pair. All four panels
use the same scales so their points can be compared directly.

```{r four-panels}
groups <- expand.grid(am = 0:1, vs = 0:1)
panels <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(groups)), function(i) {
  list(
    left = if (groups$am[i] == 0) "0%" else "58%",
    top = if (groups$vs[i] == 0) "0%" else "58%",
    width = "42%",
    height = "36%",
    offset = 0,
    lineWidth = 1,
    tickWidth = 1,
    tickLength = 4,
    tickColor = "#45545d",
    lineColor = "#45545d",
    labels = list(
      enabled = TRUE,
      step = 1,
      style = list(width = "30px", textOverflow = "clip")
    ),
    startOnTick = FALSE,
    endOnTick = FALSE,
    showFirstLabel = TRUE,
    showLastLabel = TRUE,
    title = list(text = NULL)
  )
})
x_axes <- lapply(panels, function(p) {
  c(p, list(min = 1, max = 6, tickPositions = 2:5))
})
y_axes <- lapply(panels, function(p) {
  c(p, list(min = 8, max = 36, tickPositions = c(10, 20, 30)))
})
grid <- highchart() |>
  hc_chart(alignTicks = FALSE, animation = FALSE, margin = c(60, 22, 60, 38)) |>
  hc_title(text = "Weight and fuel economy") |>
  hc_subtitle(
    text = "Columns: automatic / manual. Rows: V-shaped / straight."
  ) |>
  hc_legend(enabled = FALSE) |>
  hc_xAxis(x_axes) |>
  hc_yAxis(y_axes)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
  cars <- mtcars[mtcars$am == groups$am[i] & mtcars$vs == groups$vs[i], ]
  grid <- hc_add_series(
    grid,
    cars,
    "scatter",
    hcaes(wt, mpg),
    name = paste("am", groups$am[i], "vs", groups$vs[i]),
    xAxis = i - 1L,
    yAxis = i - 1L,
    marker = list(symbol = "circle")
  )
}
grid
```
